purpose: Planning candidates, not a recovered Power Atlas source list or production import manifest

sources.name: WRI Global Power Plant Database
sources.notes: Historical v1.3.0 baseline; data CC BY 4.0 statement must accompany the selected artifact. Not current operating status.

sources.name: GEM Global Integrated Power Tracker
sources.notes: Current-source candidate; verify actual download, thresholds, units/phases and row-level license exceptions, including solar TransitionZero notices.

sources.name: EIA-860
sources.notes: Annual U.S. generator inventory. Preserve plant plus generator composite keys and reporting year.

sources.name: EIA-860M
sources.notes: Preliminary monthly generator supplement; distinguish reporting month and preliminary status from annual records.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.notes: ODbL source. Preserve type/id/version and region coverage. No browser Overpass calls; extraction method and combined database obligations need review.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.notes: Facility/network/IX objects and explicit relationships; verify guest endpoint behavior, current terms and fields. Exclude personal contacts and unsupported physical links.

sources.name: Berkeley Lab Queued Up
sources.notes: Generation/storage queue source family, not a data-center load queue. Null geometry allowed; reporting version and queue IDs required.

sources.name: ERCOT public large-load information
sources.notes: Official source explains aggregation of confidential customer load information. Use aggregate coverage panels; no reverse identification or invented facility points.

sources.name: TeleGeography
sources.notes: Current guidance distinguishes map-image reuse from underlying licensed databases. No automatic approval to copy cable geometry or capacity data.

sources.name: CelesTrak GP data
sources.notes: Explicit OMM-compatible JSON FORMAT; up to nine-digit catalog IDs; retain epoch and use centralized snapshot ingestion compliant with current usage policy.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.notes: Public-domain overview geography per provider terms. Pin the exact archive/version; not detailed street or parcel coverage.

sources.name: FCC submarine cable licensing reference
sources.notes: Candidate official pointer only; page could not be read in this research pass. Locate and verify current official search/filing links before implementing an adapter. Do not invent an API contract.
